verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 7 anchor because it is a readable, deliberately structured operational map with mostly disciplined registry vocabulary and clean routing, but large empty bands and uneven panel density keep it from feeling fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Failing: the ten numbered sections occupy most of the width, but the broad gap above the rebuild row and the substantial empty area beneath it leave conspicuous dead bands.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Mostly registry-disciplined teal, pink, blue, green, yellow, and gray are used consistently, though the yellow document-source block and prominent purple feedback routing read as visible departures.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions or obvious waypoint markers are visible, but several very long dashed return paths and tightly bent connectors expose the routing construction more than a polished pin-up would.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Panel headers and primary rows hold clear horizontal registers, but sparse sections 8–10, oversized containers, and inconsistent internal density weaken the overall rhythm.
